title: The Great Double Whopper with Cheese War
subtitle: A multiversal war that will soon come to pass. Probably.

infobox.Effect on culture: Everyone in the [[kanye-system|Kanye System]] loves Burger King

lead: **The Great Double Whopper with Cheese War** is a prophesied "multiversal war" that "will soon come to pass" as of July 4th, 1995. It is the reason "everyone loves Burger King in the Kanye System".

sections.heading: What is known
sections.body: [[chapter-1]] says there are "tales and prophecies" about the war. The details are not given. [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese|The Great Double Whopper with Cheese]] is both its namesake and its prize, since whoever holds it has its power. The prologue's fight with [[ton-618]] may be a battle of this war ([[final-battle-with-ton-618]]).

title: The Very Violent and Vivid Prophecy
subtitle: Valuable. Vibrant. Vinny shall not be in Vain.

quote.text: The Very Violent and Vivid Prophecy will come to pass because of how Valuable and Vibrant it is because of how much Vinny shall not be in Vain.

lead: **The Very Violent and Vivid Prophecy** (the **Final Prophecy**) is the line that opens [[chapter-prologue]]. The text promises it "will come to pass" because [[vinny]] "shall not be in Vain". Its Vs are why the group around him is called [[vigorous-v|The VIGOROUS V]].

sections.heading: Meaning
sections.body: The prophecy is not explained. It is paired with the fight against [[ton-618]], which is the subject of the prologue ([[final-battle-with-ton-618]]). It is separate from [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese-war|The Great Double Whopper with Cheese War]], the other prophecy in the text.

loc.note: The Legend Of Chris has its own Prophecy: a phone with six apps and a Verizon plan, filled with DETERMINATION.

title: The Age of Claude
subtitle: July 4th to October 29th, 1995. Began with a portal, ended with an Uber.

infobox.Aim: Replace humans with data centers and robots

lead: **The Age of Claude** is what [[chapter-2]] says begins when the portal seals: "The Age of Claude had begun." It is also the title of [[chapter-3]].

sections.heading: So far
sections.body: In the era's first hours, [[claude]] flies into the [[united-states-of-america|United States]] to start building data centers ([[clash-over-the-usa]]), and [[vinny]] begins to gather allies against him ([[dunkin-alliance]]). The era's length is not given.

sections.heading: How it ended
sections.body: Claude spends three months streaming and building data centers ([[claude-livestreams]]). The [[dunkin-alliance|Dunkin Alliance]], trained in [[ways-of-freedom|the ways of Freedom]], loses the [[battle-of-louisiana|Battle of Louisiana]], but [[vellatosis|Vellatosis]] turns it ([[day-of-the-bagel-man]]). "The job was finished. The Age of Claude was over." Claude himself had just said it "is just beginning".

title: Vellatosis
subtitle: Not just a game theory. 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, and so forth.

infobox.Effect: The subject grows an extra eye, leg and arm, then splits in two, repeatedly

lead: **Vellatosis** is the process by which [[will-vella]] becomes an army. [[vinny]] first hears of it as a rumor ("Isn't that just a theory? A game theory?"). [[claude]] turns out to know the secret, explains "the mysteries of Vellatosis, the explanation and how to achieve it", and is beaten by the result.

sections.heading: The deal
sections.body: Vinny offers to help find the secret in exchange for Will's help against [[claude]] ([[dunkin-alliance]]). Will agrees. "Soon I will have an army. An army of Vella's. Vellatosis will begin."

sections.heading: How it happens
sections.body: "Will Vella then starts shaking. Will starts growing another eye, a leg, and an arm. Suddenly he splits into 2 Vellas, which split into 4, then 8, then 16, then 32, then 64, then 128, and so forth." The explanation itself is not printed. The narrator adds that "Vellatosis has not been completed yet", while the number of Vellas keeps growing ([[day-of-the-bagel-man]]).

title: DETERMINATION
subtitle: In capital letters. Vinny has it.

infobox.Feeling: Filled with it before the fight with [[ton-618]]

lead: **DETERMINATION** is what [[vinny]] is "filled with" in the prologue, "to take this motherfucker DOWN", as he faces [[ton-618]]. It is always written in capital letters.

sections.heading: Use
sections.body: It appears alongside "the power of The Great Double Whopper with Cheese", which also flows through Vinny. Together they are what makes him ready to fight ([[chapter-prologue]]).

loc.note: In The Legend Of Chris, the Prophecy says the team will be filled with [DETERMINATION], in brackets.

title: No-clipping
subtitle: Walking through walls, on purpose or otherwise.
lead: **No-clipping** is how characters in [[chapter-1]] pass through walls: [[vinny]] and [[tyrone]] "walk into the wall" of the [[freezer]], [[garret]] "no-clips to somewhere" when hit by a forklift, and [[friend|FRIEND]] carries them "before no-clipping into a wall".

sections.heading: Uses
sections.body: It is used as transport in the [[backrooms]] ([[friend-abduction]]) and as an accident ([[forklift-incident]]). The story never says where the walls lead.

title: "Nuh uh" / "Yuh huh"
subtitle: Five rounds. No winner. Moves on.

infobox.Resolved by: Tyrone: "I think there might be more in storage."

lead: **"Nuh uh" / "Yuh huh"** is the argument Vinny and Tyrone have in [[chapter-1]] about whether the restaurant has run out of Double Whoppers with Cheese. It ends when Tyrone suggests the storage room.

sections.heading: The exchange
sections.body: "Vinny we ran out of Double Whoppers with Cheese." "Nuh uh." "Yuh huh." The two repeat the pair five times, and then Tyrone says, "I think there might be more in storage." Vinny answers, "Aight, bet." ([[aight-bet]])

loc.note: The Legend Of Chris has a 303-utterance Nuh Uh–Yuh Huh Debate between Bon Jovi and RFK.

title: "Aight, bet"
subtitle: Vinny's answer to dangerous ideas.
lead: **"Aight, bet"** is [[vinny]]'s agreement phrase. He says it when [[tyrone]] suggests checking storage ([[chapter-1]]), and again when [[claude]] tells him how to open the portal ([[chapter-2]]).

sections.heading: Uses
sections.body: Each use is followed by a major escalation. The first leads into the [[backrooms]]. The second leads to [[opening-of-the-portal|the portal]] and [[claude-escape|Claude's escape]].

loc.note: In The Legend Of Chris, "Aight Bet" is Plankton's answer to almost everything.

title: Lying
subtitle: "An advanced technique." Very strongly used in acts of war.
lead: **Lying** is called "an advanced technique" by the narrator when [[vinny]] tells the castle's doorkeeper that he is the person who sent Claude "foot pics". The narrator adds, "It's very strongly used in acts of war. Even though Vinny isn't at war right now."

sections.heading: Result
sections.body: The lie opens [[claudes-castle|the castle]] to Vinny, who is welcomed as [[polydoros|Polydoros]]. It holds up with the [[ai-shadow-butler|butler]] and almost fails at the [[claude|throne room]] door.

title: "Wordle? More like Word-shit"
subtitle: A diss track about a word game. Now the most popular song.

infobox.Status: Released; "the most popular song as of right now" ([[chapter-4]])

lead: **"Wordle? More like Word-shit"** is the song [[aesop-rock]] and [[del-the-funky-homosapien|Del]] are working on at the [[dunkin-wyoming|Dunkin]]. They failed Wordle "that miserably" that they "completely lost it" and started a diss track about it.

sections.heading: Lyrics so far
sections.body: Del: "Yeah, Yeah, you know what time it is, Me and Aesop dunking inside Dunkin on this piece of shit game." Aesop: "What What." Del: "Wordle is the name and it doesn't have enough shame." Aesop: "Tell em', Del."

sections.heading: Success
sections.body: By November 2nd, 1995, the song "blew up and is the most popular song as of right now. Want me to play it? Too bad you don't have spotify premium, bitch."

title: The Banishing of the AI
subtitle: Fired by AI. Pissed. Banished it.
lead: **The Banishing of the AI** is the backstory event in which "all of the people who got laid-off or fired because of AI got pretty pissed and came together to banish it in the year 1972". They sent it to the [[little-saint-james-sea|Little Saint James Sea]].

sections.heading: Consequences
sections.body: The narrator chains the result: that sea is "where the Shadow Realm is. Which is where the AI is. Which is where the Shadows are. Which is where the AI now rules." The AI's ruler is [[claude]], who still resents it.

title: TON 618's Conquest of the Kanye System
subtitle: Giant man. Blue light. Then a long nap.

infobox.Claimed cause: Possibly the power of [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese|The Great Double Whopper with Cheese]]

lead: **TON 618's Conquest of the Kanye System** is the backstory event in which [[ton-618]] "became shaped like a giant man", "realized it had great power", turned bright blue, and "conquered the Kanye System".

sections.heading: Cause and aftermath
sections.body: "Many say that the TON 618 consumed the power of The Great Double Whopper with Cheese to conquer all things. Many say otherwise." Since the conquest, TON 618 "has been at rest, waiting to wake again." In the prologue it has.

timeline.when: Before the story: millions of years ago

title: Independence Day, 1995
subtitle: The day it all starts. The boss said no.
lead: **Independence Day, 1995** is the date the story's main timeline begins. The text says "the year is 1995, July 4th", and that [[vinny]]'s British boss refuses to give him the day off.

sections.heading: The day
sections.body: Vinny's shift starts normally and then passes through the [[freezer]] into the [[backrooms]]. Everything up to the forming of the [[dunkin-alliance|Dunkin Alliance]] happens on this same day: the ship, the drowning, the Shadow Realm, and Wyoming. [[chapter-3]] only says "July 5th" once the Alliance has driven off into the night. The text only dates the start.

title: The Forklift Incident
subtitle: Donuts. Garret. A wall.

infobox.Outcome: Garret no-clips away; the forklift becomes a toy

lead: **The Forklift Incident** is the moment in the [[backrooms]] when [[vinny]] spins out on [[garret]]'s [[forklift]] and hits Garret. Garret flies into a wall and [[no-clip|no-clips]] away.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.body: Garret is on break and lets them use the forklift. Vinny takes the keys, does donuts, and yells a long "WOOO" with "gambling" in the middle. After the crash he admits, "Aw shit. I forgot I'm not forklift certified." He and [[tyrone]] "take turns playing with the forklift instead of doing their fucking job."

title: The Cat in the Box
subtitle: "Cat." "Cat." "Cat."
lead: **The Cat in the Box** is the short scene where a black cat, who turns out to be [[friend|FRIEND]], jumps into a box of Double Whoppers with Cheese. [[vinny]] and [[tyrone]] stop their play to look and say "Cat" in sync.

sections.heading: The scene
sections.body: The cat's head turns, "revealing its yellow and pink eyes", and it laughs and disappears. Vinny says, "Welp, things really took a weird route back there, let's go back to work-", which is cut off by [[friend|FRIEND]] ([[friend-abduction]]). It gives [[chapter-2]] its title.

title: FRIEND's Abduction
subtitle: Wrong delivery, correct wall.
lead: **FRIEND's Abduction** is how [[vinny]] and [[tyrone]] leave the [[backrooms]]. [[friend|FRIEND]] appears behind them, grabs both, "runs throughout the backrooms before no-clipping into a wall", and delivers them to Captain [[wing-ding-gaster|Gaster]].

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: FRIEND had been sent for Double Whoppers with Cheese. Gaster explains that he wanted "DOUBLE WHOPPERS WITH CHEESE, NOT HUMANS!!!!", which FRIEND answers with a soggy Double Whopper without Cheese ([[chapter-2]]).

title: The Little Saint James Detour
subtitle: A quick escape from being extremely political.

infobox.Cause: Gaster's theory that the island held the Great Double Whopper with Cheese

lead: **The Little Saint James Detour** is the ship's brief approach to [[little-saint-james-island|an island]]. [[wing-ding-gaster|Gaster]] sights a small building through his [[spyglass]], and the [[ss-vessel|S.S. Vessel]] immediately speeds away.

sections.heading: The argument
sections.body: Vinny asks, "What were you thinking, you bastard?!" Gaster says the island's secret might have been that it had [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese|The Great Double Whopper with Cheese]]. Vinny says only [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese-god|the god]] has it, and that Gaster is "almost as stupid as Taking Back Sunday". That insult leads straight to [[roaring-knights-strike]].

title: The Roaring Knight's Strike
subtitle: Insult the band, get the BLACK KNIFE. Drown. Not quite.
lead: **The Roaring Knight's Strike** is when [[roaring-knight|Roary]] hits [[vinny]] with the [[black-knife|BLACK KNIFE]] and he "falls off the S.S. Vessel and into the ocean". Vinny can swim to the [[little-saint-james-island|island]] or drown. "Guess I'll die," he says, and dives.

sections.heading: Drowning
sections.body:
"He starts losing consciousness after a minute and twenty-four seconds. Is it so joever for Vinny?" The narrator immediately answers: "Nah, we're so BARACK." Shadows from the sea carry him to the [[ai-shadow-realm|AI Shadow Realm]].

Before he falls, [[tyrone]] shouts, "Tell the big brit boss that I quit, Vinny!"

title: The Smash Match
subtitle: Vinny (Greninja) vs. Claude (Mr. Game & Watch). Controller dispute.

infobox.Game: [[super-smash-bros-wii-u|Super Smash Bros. for the Wii U]]
infobox.Stakes: Claude wins: Vinny frees him. Vinny wins: Claude leaves.

lead: **The Smash Match** is the match [[claude]] proposes to settle whether he is freed. [[vinny]] plays Greninja, Claude plays Mr. Game & Watch, and the [[ai-shadow-figures|AI shadow figures]] cheer. It goes to sudden death, where Claude side-smashes Vinny off the stage.

sections.heading: Aftermath
sections.body: Vinny complains that "I was using the crappy controller!" Claude repeats "Copium" many times. Vinny honors the deal and asks how to open the portal ([[opening-of-the-portal]]).

title: The Opening of the Portal
subtitle: One fork. One burst of darkness that shines.
lead: **The Opening of the Portal** is how [[vinny]] honors his Smash bet: he stabs [[the-fork|the fork]] into the middle of the room, and "a burst of darkness shines in the room". The [[the-portal|portal]] above opens, and he and [[claude]] see "the bright blue sky".

sections.heading: The conversation
sections.body: Before the stab, Claude says Vinny needs "a fork in the road", Vinny produces it, and they discuss the pun. Vinny asks whether it will make a Dark Fountain; Claude says no. Vinny: "Aight bet." ([[aight-bet]])

title: Claude's Escape
subtitle: "Try and stop me." The Age of Claude begins.

infobox.Where: [[ai-shadow-realm|AI Shadow Realm]] to the sky of [[garth|Garth]]

lead: **Claude's Escape** is the moment [[claude]] flies out of the [[the-portal|portal]]. Vinny tells him, "You won't get away with this." Claude answers, "Try and stop me, pussy."

sections.heading: After
sections.body: The [[ai-shadow-figures|AI shadow figures]] thank Vinny for "freeing us from him" and give him the [[shadow-cape|Shadow Cape]]. He follows Claude out, and the portal seals behind him. "The Age of Claude had begun."

title: The Clash Over the USA
subtitle: Stoppable force. Immovable object. Wyoming.

infobox.Where: The sky over the [[united-states-of-america|United States]], then [[wyoming|Wyoming]]
infobox.Outcome: Vinny is thrown into a mountain in Wyoming

lead: **The Clash Over the USA** is the first round of [[vinny]] against [[claude]] on [[garth]]. Vinny flies into Claude "at full speed", becoming "the stoppable force against an immovable object". Claude chokes him and throws him into [[wyoming|Wyoming]].

sections.heading: Before and after
sections.body: Claude has just flown into the [[united-states-of-america|United States]], remarking that it "needs more data centers". Vinny crashes into a mountain and lies in pain for "about 6 hours and 8 minutes", until the sun goes down. He then goes in search of Dunkin ([[dunkin-alliance]]).

title: The Dunkin Alliance
subtitle: Four people, one table, one common enemy who likes Wordle. Disbanded, forever.

infobox.Price: Help with [[vellatosis]] for Will; the rest just need [[wordle|Wordle]]
infobox.Vehicles: [[mystery-machine|The Mystery Machine]]; [[uha-ford-f150|the UHA Ford-F150]]; an Uber

lead: **The Dunkin Alliance** is the team [[vinny]] assembles at the [[dunkin-wyoming|Dunkin]] after being thrown into [[wyoming|Wyoming]]. It is made of [[will-vella|Will Vella]], [[aesop-rock]] and [[del-the-funky-homosapien|Del]].

sections.heading: Recruiting
sections.body: Vinny offers Will help finding the secret of [[vellatosis]] if Will helps defeat [[claude]] ("Sounds baller"). Then he and Will sit at the rappers' table, and Vinny asks them for help against a super-AI "trying to take over the world with Data-centers and Robots". They are unmoved until he says, "He likes Wordle." Del: "We're in."

sections.heading: The campaign
sections.body: The Alliance loses the [[mystery-machine|Mystery Machine]] ([[mystery-machine-crash]]), learns [[two-time-teleportation|to teleport]], lands in Texas ([[teleport-to-austin]]) and trains with the UHA for three months ([[freedom-road-trip]]). It then loses the [[battle-of-louisiana|Battle of Louisiana]] after six hours, and wins anyway through [[vellatosis|Vellatosis]].

sections.heading: The end
sections.body: "The Dunkin Alliance disbands, forever. They all call an Uber because they have no way to get back home." Will has already left with the [[dunkin-cult|Dunkin Cult]]; Aesop and Del return to Wyoming; Vinny returns to the register ([[chapter-4]]).

title: The Final Battle with TON 618
subtitle: Promised in the prologue. Not yet told.

infobox.Where: The [[kanye-system|Kanye System]], next to the TON 618
infobox.Status: Only the first moments have been shown

lead: **The Final Battle with TON 618** is the fight the prologue begins and Chapter 1 abandons. [[vinny]] "stares at the TON 618, emitting a blue glow" and says, "Bring it on, you fucking bastard." "The battle begins."

sections.heading: What is known
sections.body: Vinny has [[vinnys-sword|a vibrant sword]], [[titanium-armor|titanium armor]], a [[shadow-cape|cape of shadows]], the power of [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese|The Great Double Whopper with Cheese]], and [[determination|DETERMINATION]]. Behind him is [[vigorous-v|The VIGOROUS V]]. The outcome is not given.
